title: Find Players With Zero or One Loss
problemStatement: Given the results of multiple matches, where each match contains a winner and a loser, determine: • All players who never lost. • All players who lost exactly once. Print both lists in ascending order.
input: • First line contains integer M representing the number of matches. • Next M lines each contain two integers representing Winner and Loser.
output: Print the players with zero losses followed by the players with exactly one loss.
